title: payment.collections.payment.captured
description: A tenant's customer paid the tenant online (ADR-0024 §8, tenant collections): a collection moved to `captured` on a signature-verified merchant webhook or a server-to-server status check against the provider — never on a browser's word. Emitted exactly once per collection. Deliberately never `commerce.payment.*`: a merchant's payments must never reach the subscription dunning loop. `operations` consumes it to record the order's `paid_at` fact. Carries identifiers and money only — no person.
